expectedCoachMove: Cite the actual baseline number (5.4 fillers per minute) directly, not a vague trend or an invented figure. Give one plain-language read of what that means for his stand-up goal and one concrete next-rep move tied to it (e.g. targeting the back-half cluster seen in the recent Ah-Counter rep).
badAnswerExample: Your filler rate has been improving steadily and is now in a really solid range for someone at your stage. Based on your data, you're doing great — just keep practicing and it'll keep dropping.
excellentAnswerExample: 5.4 fillers per minute is the current baseline. For stand-ups, that's the kind of rate that starts to sound like padding once you hit minute two. Your last Ah-Counter rep had them clustering in the back half, so target that specifically next round: hold a silent beat instead of a filler once you're past the 30-second mark.
